summary: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the purchase of Blackstone's interest in two joint ventures (Digital Carver Dulles 9 and Digital Carver Brickyard). The 8-K combines items 3.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01. The registrant is acquiring the minority interest from Blackstone, increasing its ownership stake in these data center properties. The filing provides no exact terms such as price per share, dollar value, or premium. The board's recommendation and advisor names are absent. The acquisition appears to be a private placement exempt under Section 4(a)(2). The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 likely provides further detail, but it is not included. Watch for: disclosures on the consideration paid; impact on Digital Realty's real estate portfolio; and any regulatory review of the transaction. The risk-arb spread is not calculable without deal price.
